Create a contrast

Source: R/design.R
create_contrast.Rd

Creates the contrast that compares the treatment group(s) with the control group(s) of a design matrix created with create_design_matrix. When more than one group is given on one side, their average is used.

Usage

create_contrast(design, treatment, control)

Arguments

design

A design matrix created with create_design_matrix.

treatment

The name(s) of the treatment group(s), as in the groups of the ScreenR object or as in the column names of the design matrix.

control

The name(s) of the control group(s), as in the groups of the ScreenR object or as in the column names of the design matrix.

Value

A named numeric vector with one value for each column of the design matrix: 1 / (number of treatment groups) for the treatment groups, -1 / (number of control groups) for the control groups and 0 for the others.

See also

create_design_matrix, find_camera_hit, find_roast_hit

Examples

object <- get0("object", envir = asNamespace("ScreenR"))
design <- create_design_matrix(object)
create_contrast(design, treatment = "Treated", control = "Control")
#> Control   T1.T2 Treated 
#>      -1       0       1
